_comment: freud.density standalone analysis parameter file for analyze_density.py. Set any 'enabled' to false to skip that analysis.

rdf._comment: RDF g(r). Set r_cut explicitly before running; coordination is integrated from r_min to r_cut.

correlation_function._comment: CorrelationFunction – complex pairwise spatial correlation C(r). value_mode='orientation_k' needs usable particle orientations in the GSD; 'ones' does not.

local_density._comment: LocalDensity – per-particle local number density. r_max is the probe radius; diameter is the particle diameter.

gaussian_density._comment: GaussianDensity – Gaussian-blurred density field on a grid. Default behavior is snapshot-style unless frame_average_override is set true.

sphere_voxelization._comment: SphereVoxelization – binary voxel occupancy grid. Usually used as a last-frame snapshot analysis.
